_comment: Named actions of stagekit.actions: actor.do(name, ...). Generated by `python tools/clip.py actions --rescan`; 'bodies', 'sources' and 'covers' are written by hand. See docs/ADDING_NEW_ACTIONS.md.

actions.name: walk
actions.summary: walk to a place on the walk cycle, feet planted (ghost: floats, mermaid: swims)

bodies.mermaid: swims: glides low with a small bob
bodies.aj: Mixamo Standard_Walk; planted feet held by leg IK; eases in and out to Standing_Idle

sources: The Cook and the Golden Cup / 2:target
The River and the Dry Feet / 4:attempt_three
Two Seconds at the Office Door / 2:opportunist

actions.name: run
actions.summary: run to a place: long strides, body forward, elbows pumping

bodies.aj: Mixamo Standard_Run; planted feet held by leg IK

sources: The Crown on the Red Carpet / 2:attempt_one
The Man in the Bee Suit / 3:improvise
Two Seconds at the Office Door / 1:mistake

actions.name: sneak
actions.summary: creep to a place: knees bent, careful high steps, hands held up (also tiptoe)

actions.name: tiptoe
actions.summary: tiptoe: the sneak cycle, upright and a little faster

actions.name: step_forward
actions.summary: one decisive step toward the facing side
sources: The Cook and the Golden Cup / 4:reversal
The Crown on the Red Carpet / 1:catch
The River and the Dry Feet / 1:catch

actions.name: pace
actions.summary: walk up and down in agitation (three legs)
sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 4:reveal

actions.name: stomp
actions.summary: angry stomp on the spot: fists down, one foot slammed twice

bodies.no_legs: fists down and two squashes, no foot

sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 4:reveal

actions.name: sit_down
actions.summary: sit: a small lean forward, then down onto a seat at knee height (mermaid: settles on her tail)

bodies.no_legs: the body settles a third of the hip height lower
bodies.aj: Mixamo Stand_To_Sit (steps back about 0.39 m; hit = the seat); on=seat lifts the hips to the seat top

sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 3:ego
The River and the Dry Feet / 4:attempt_three

actions.name: sit_idle
actions.summary: stay seated: small shifts of weight and a look around
sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 3:ego
The Photo of the New Keys / 0:contrast

actions.name: stand_up
actions.summary: rise from sitting, kneeling or crouching

bodies.aj: Sit_To_Stand / Kneel_To_Stand / Getting_Up by the pose it starts from (hit = up)

sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 4:reveal
The River and the Dry Feet / 4:attempt_three

actions.name: kneel
actions.summary: drop to the knees
sources: The Crown on the Red Carpet / 4:attempt_three

actions.name: crouch
actions.summary: squat low on the spot (hide, lurk, look at something on the ground)

actions.name: hide
actions.summary: duck down behind cover, then peek over it
sources: The Paper That Trapped the Mayor / 3:ego

actions.name: peek
actions.summary: lean the head and shoulders out from behind something, look, pull back
sources: The Cook and the Golden Cup / 0:mission

actions.name: lie_down
actions.summary: lie flat on the back on the ground

bodies.aj: Getting_Up played backward at 1.6x, then Laying_Idle

sources: The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 4:escape

actions.name: sleep
actions.summary: asleep: eyes shut, slow deep breathing (lying if lie_down came first, else nodding off upright)

bodies.aj: Mixamo Sleeping_Idle when lying (else the procedural nod-off)

actions.name: wake_up
actions.summary: wake with a start and sit / stand up
sources: Three Rules Cut in the Desk / 4:breach

actions.name: fall
actions.summary: fall over: arms fly up, the figure tips and lands flat (to=(x, y, z) to fall down to a place)

bodies.aj: Mixamo Falling_Back: always backward (hit = the ground); to= is procedural

sources: The Crown on the Red Carpet / 2:attempt_one

actions.name: get_up
actions.summary: get back on the feet after a fall or lying down

bodies.aj: Mixamo Getting_Up from its rise (hit = up)

actions.name: slip
actions.summary: a foot shoots out, arms windmill, down on the back

bodies.aj: Mixamo Stumble_Backwards (ends sitting on the floor; hit = the ground)

sources: The River and the Dry Feet / 2:attempt_one

actions.name: jump
actions.summary: jump on the spot or to a place (to=): crouch, leave the ground, land with a squash

bodies.mermaid: a leap out of the water shape: rises and drops
bodies.aj: Mixamo Jump on the spot (hit = take-off); to= is procedural

sources: The Crown on the Red Carpet / 2:attempt_one
The River and the Dry Feet / 2:attempt_one

actions.name: climb
actions.summary: climb up or down to a place (ladder, rope, wall): hands reach one after the other

bodies.no_legs: rises with the hands reaching in turn

sources: Three Rules Cut in the Desk / 4:breach

actions.name: hang
actions.summary: hang from the hands (a branch, a rope, a ledge) and swing a little

actions.name: swim
actions.summary: tread water or swim to a place (to=): body low, arms sweeping (mermaid: tail strokes)
sources: The River and the Dry Feet / 2:attempt_one

actions.name: crawl
actions.summary: down on the belly and pull forward with the arms to a place

bodies.mermaid: drags herself by the arms: her natural move on land

actions.name: roll
actions.summary: roll along the ground to a place like a log
sources: The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 4:escape

actions.name: struggle
actions.summary: stuck fast (mud, a trap, a grip): strain upward, twist, strain again
sources: The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 0:countdown
The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 1:kill_exit
The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 3:failed_attempt

actions.name: lean_on
actions.summary: lean the weight forward onto something (a counter, a staff, a wall)
sources: The Sand That Would Not Let Go / 3:failed_attempt

actions.name: turn_around
actions.summary: turn sharply to face the other way
sources: The Man in the Bee Suit / 2:trigger

actions.name: freeze
actions.summary: stop dead mid-movement and hold perfectly still, wide-eyed
sources: The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 3:ego

actions.name: recoil
actions.summary: jerk back from something: hands up in front, body back, a half step away
sources: The Cook and the Golden Cup / 4:reversal

actions.name: ride
actions.summary: seated holding reins or a wheel (horse, cart, car): hands forward, a steady bob
sources: The Letter on the Card Table / 4:reveal
The River and the Dry Feet / 3:attempt_two

sources: The Crown on the Red Carpet / 4:attempt_three

The Letter on the Card Table / 2:clue_blunder

sources: The Paper That Trapped the Mayor / 4:reveal
The Photo of the New Keys / 1:mistake

actions.name: show
actions.summary: hold a thing out in front for someone to see (chest height)

The Photo of the New Keys / 4:collapse

Two Seconds at the Office Door / 2:opportunist

actions.name: beckon
actions.summary: palm up, curl the hand toward the body twice: come here

sources: The Letter on the Card Table / 3:ego
The Paper That Trapped the Mayor / 2:clue_blunder

actions.name: pull
actions.summary: grab a thing with both hands and heave back (by=(dx, dy) also moves the thing)

actions.name: open_door

actions.name: turn_key
actions.summary: hand to a lock, a handle or a dial and twist the wrist (lock, unlock, turn a knob)

actions.name: press

sources: Two Seconds at the Office Door / 1:mistake

actions.name: tap
actions.summary: tap things one by one with a finger (counting): targets=[...] or the air in front

actions.name: knock
actions.summary: rap on a door with the knuckles three times

actions.name: take_out
actions.summary: hand into a pocket or bag and out again holding a thing (prop appears in the hand)
sources: The Man in the Bee Suit / 2:trigger

actions.name: stash

The Paper That Trapped the Mayor / 3:ego

The Gold the Guards Laughed At / 2:clue_blunder

actions.name: eat

actions.name: light

actions.name: blow

The Letter on the Card Table / 4:reveal

actions.name: smile

actions.name: cry

actions.name: angry

The Duel He Won Sitting Still / 4:reveal

The Letter on the Card Table / 4:reveal

actions.name: hug
actions.summary: two characters close in and put their arms round each other

actions.name: whisper

actions.name: argue

actions.name: chase

actions.name: curtsy

bodies.no_legs: a dip of the whole body
bodies.mermaid: a dip of the whole body

actions.name: salute
actions.summary: snap the flat hand to the brow, hold, drop it

actions.name: plead

actions.name: pat_back

actions.name: shout
actions.summary: shout or call out: body forward, mouth wide, a hand cupped at the mouth or a fist up (an Aj uses a free hand: never one that holds a prop or that the shot has posed)

actions.name: juggle

bodies.no_legs: no knee dip; the body bobs
